evidence.summary: Illustrative source review only; no live application or real tenant data.

coverage.area: Object access is scoped to the authenticated tenant
coverage.rationale: Synthetic fixture omits the owner predicate; runtime exploitability was not tested.
This inert example has no application server.

findings.title: Possible missing object-owner check
findings.impact: If the fixture reflected a reachable real route, another tenant might read an object; the example proves no live exposure.
findings.remediation: Bind the data lookup to trusted tenant identity and preserve admin exceptions explicitly.
findings.verification: In an authorized synthetic test environment, use two owned accounts and assert the second account cannot read or update the first account object.

limitations: Synthetic schema example and illustrative timestamps/hashes; no target audit, advisory freshness check or production test was run.
